name: sns
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk AWS SNS (Simple Notification Service) topic, provisioned within an environment and resource group.

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this SNS topic.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Topic name. Letters, numbers, hyphens, and underscores. For a FIFO topic (topic_type = Fifo) the platform appends the required ".fifo" suffix automatically. Cannot be changed after creation.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment in which the topic is provisioned.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group in which the topic is provisioned.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this topic to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: topic_type
attributes.description: Topic type: Standard (best-effort ordering, at-least-once delivery) or Fifo (strict ordering, exactly-once). Immutable after creation.

attributes.name: display_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name shown as the sender for SMS/email subscriptions. Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: content_based_deduplication
attributes.description: Enable content-based deduplication (FIFO topics only; ignored for Standard). Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: delivery_policy
attributes.description: SNS delivery policy document (JSON) controlling retry behavior for HTTP/S subscriptions. Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: encryption_mode
attributes.description: Server-side encryption mode: None (unencrypted) or SseKms (AWS KMS). Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: kms_master_key_id
attributes.description: KMS key ID or ARN used when encryption_mode is SseKms. Required when encryption_mode is SseKms. Can be changed in place.

attributes.name: tags
key
attributes.description: Tag key.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Tag value.
Tags applied to the topic at creation, as a list of key/value pairs. Platform ownership tags are added automatically.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status of the topic.

attributes.name: sns_id
attributes.description: ID of this SNS topic, for reference by dependent resources.

attributes.name: topic_arn
attributes.description: ARN of the provisioned SNS topic.

attributes.name: created_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the topic was created (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: updated_at
attributes.description: Timestamp when the topic was last updated (RFC 3339).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version counter, incremented on each update.
